seasonRaceMode.scorePolicy: Only actual verified workbook score fields: eligible final score; ineligible computed award raw composite without eligibility gating when source formula and underlying inputs are verified; no normalization invented. Source currentAwardScoring must match completed HTO games before publishing.
seasonRaceMode.reason: Workbook award values not reconciled to four verified 2026/27 HTO games; one game in available workbook.
seasonRaceMode.shortlistFillPolicy: Eligible players always occupy leading places, ranked among themselves by workbook award-specific Rank Key; provisional noneligible players then fill any remaining places up to five, ranked by workbook raw composite (or measured points/goals for scoring titles). Once five eligible players exist, no provisional names appear.
seasonRaceMode.sourceFreshness: HTO-fed season data plus independently validated AwardScoring calculation; HTO projection-bridge parity does not itself verify AwardScoring.
seasonRaceMode.partialRosterPolicy: If 1–4 scored players have actually dressed this season, display only those players. Never fill a board with zero-game players.
seasonRaceMode.leaderboardOrder: Eligible played players first by workbook Rank Key; remaining spots filled by played provisional players ranked by exact, source-validated workbook model; no fabricated entries or scores.

awards.name: Hart Award
awards.subtitle: Most Valuable Player
awards.eligibility: FT, CU and DI players with roster-season games recorded. Skaters: greater of 5 GP or 50% of roster games, rounded up. Goalies: greater of 3 GP or 30%, rounded up. Workbook scoring type and current total played-game fields apply.
awards.weight: Production, POTG, clutch contribution, consistency and position-specific impact.

awards.name: Conn Smythe Award
awards.subtitle: Playoff MVP
awards.eligibility: Playoff data required. Played-game threshold is two-thirds of playoff games when the game count is odd, otherwise one-half.

awards.name: Art Ross Award
awards.subtitle: Regular-season points leader
awards.eligibility: AwardScoring-eligible skaters; regular-season results only, excluding playoffs.
awards.weight: Regular-season points. Tiebreak wording and the workbook's internal Rank Key require reconciliation before publication.

awards.name: Rocket Richard Trophy
awards.subtitle: Regular-season goal-scoring title
awards.eligibility: AwardScoring-eligible regular-season skaters; playoff goals excluded; ties may be recognized.

awards.name: James Norris Trophy
awards.subtitle: Top defenceman
awards.eligibility: FT/CU/DI skaters classified by the workbook as Defense, Defence or Utility. Greater of 7 total played games or 35% of roster-season games, rounded up.
awards.weight: Defensive profile is most heavily weighted.

awards.name: Lady Byng Award
awards.subtitle: Sportsmanship and disciplined play
awards.eligibility: FT/CU/DI players with roster-season games recorded. Skaters: greater of 5 GP or 50% of roster games, rounded up. Goalies: greater of 3 GP or 30%, rounded up.

awards.name: Rookie of the Year
awards.subtitle: Top first-year full-timer
awards.eligibility: Players in their first full-time roster season with at least one current game played, subject to workbook eligibility.
awards.weight: Rookie-specific performance formula; known workbook notes mismatch must be corrected before publishing.

awards.name: Most Improved Player
awards.subtitle: Progress against career baseline
awards.eligibility: Non-rookie FT/CU/DI players. Skaters require at least 5 prior-career GP and the greater of 5 current GP or 50% of roster games. Goalies require at least 2 prior-career GP and the greater of 3 current GP or 30% of roster games. Percentage thresholds round up.
awards.weight: Improvement relative to each player's earlier production, impact and discipline.

awards.name: Rolaids Relief Man Award
awards.subtitle: Top call-up / relief player
awards.eligibility: Full-time and blank roster-status entries excluded. Skaters: greater of 6 current GP or 25% of roster-season games, rounded up. Goalies: greater of 4 current GP or 15%, rounded up. Workbook scoring type and roster-season denominator must be verified.
awards.weight: Skaters: consistency 18%, points 18%, attendance 15%, POTG 10%, plus supporting impact. Goalies: attendance 20%, reliability 18%, discipline reliability 12%, GAA 10%, POTG 10%, win rate 8%, plus/minus 8%, wins 8%, shutouts 3%, offense 3%.

awards.name: Andrew Cristillo Dedication Award
awards.subtitle: Commitment, attendance and service
awards.eligibility: FT/CU/DI players with roster-season games recorded. Skaters: greater of 5 GP or 50% of roster games, rounded up. Goalies: greater of 3 GP or 30%, rounded up.
awards.weight: Current attendance 45%, playoff attendance 20%, tenure 5%, role-specific reliability 20%, discipline reliability 10%.

awards.name: Hall of Fame Ballot
awards.subtitle: Lifetime Brave H.C. contribution
awards.eligibility: At least 50 total career GP (skater + goalie), not already inducted.
awards.weight: Career production and longevity, playoff résumé, legacy, consistency and verified awards and records.

survey.ballotRule: Select exactly 2 named pilot nominees per selected award, one vote each. Highest vote total wins; model rank tiebreak. Hall of Fame top two are inducted.
survey.nomineeListSource: Static pilot Google Form, not automatically refreshed from current weekly workbook.
survey.votingGuideConflict: Separate public voting guide says rank all 5 at 5–1 points. Active pilot form uses select exactly 2. Do not conflate.

notes: Week 4 HTO team totals are independently verified, but award scores are not. Performance snapshot is informational only.
Eligibility flags are not used to hide provisional weekly races once workbook scores are verified.
The currently published pilot ballot is not automatically updated with weekly race entrants.
The workbook remains read-only; no HTO site data or form response data is altered.
Founder 2026-10-19 ruling: fill early top five with workbook-ranked provisional players, replacing them preferentially with eligible players; strictly eligible-only once five qualify.

2026-10-19 new Founder gate: zero current-season GP cannot appear on weekly award race as either eligible or provisional. Preseason board empty. With fewer than five played, publish only actual participants.
